afterHomeCastleCapture.description: royalists skip player province 4 because adjacent royalist province 3 has no mobile soldiers, capture player home province 2 from province 1, and main:L4C7A transfers province 4 to owner 0 without a separate battle

assertionsForPort: Hostile royalist target scanning can skip a player province when the only adjacent owner-0 province has no mobile soldiers.
A hostile owner-0 battle against the player's home province calls the normal main:L4C7A castle-capture transfer path.
When owner 0 captures the home province, every remaining province owned by that defeated player transfers to owner 0 without separate battles.
Non-battle transferred provinces keep their soldier counts.
The defeated player's C8FB home marker remains set in C64 memory even though the player has no remaining provinces.
